content:
ella: Quick, completely serious question: who wants to enter the "Stadium Nacho Cook-Off" during the playoff watch party? Winner gets the office mascot hat AND the privilege of naming tomorrow's lunch special. :taco: :crown:
sam: wait we have a mascot hat?? now this is serious. i'm in if nachos are judged on crunch factor. :raised_hands:
patrick: i'm terrible at nachos but amazing at creative toppings. does guac count as a performance-enhancing condiment? :avocado:
maria: can we have dietary categories? vegetarian + gluten-free should be options. also side bet: loser wears the mascot hat for an hour. :laughing:
ella: rules idea (quick):
```
- $3 entry to cover prizes + snack fund
- judging categories: Taste, Presentation, Crunch (each 1-10)
- dietary category winners get a ribbon and $5 snack credit
- overall winner gets mascot hat + names tomorrow's lunch special
- loser hat penalty = wear for one hour and take photo for #random
```
sam: spreadsheet? Also can we have a People's Choice vote via emoji?
ella: spreadsheet: https://tiny.redwood/nacho-cookoff (post emoji to confirm entry and add dietary tags). People’s Choice via :heart: reaction.
patrick: sign me up :point_up: (will bring a suspiciously hot cheese blend)
maria: sign me up :raised_hands: (vegetarian category)
kitchen-bot: Reminder: Please list any allergens in the spreadsheet. Facilities: chips and cleanup kit reserved.
ella: logistics: facilities said we can use kitchen island. bring your own small skillet or tray. we'll have three judges (ella, sam, maria) and People's Choice for fourth.
sam: can judges be bribed? hypothetically. i'm bringing a playlist and cowbell for ambience. :bell:
patrick: side-prop: if someone makes nachos that are objectively outstanding, they get +2 bonus points and a specialty sticker.
maria: can we use the mascot hat as a timer? like loser spins the hat and must do a little victory dance? public humiliation tier: medium.
ella: fine. loser dance is required. gif thread mandatory.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Stadium Nacho Cook-Off & Playoff Watch" Fri 7:00pm - invite sent to #random.
kitchen-bot: Facilities note: please return borrowed cookware within 24h. Cleaning supplies available next to the espresso machine.
sam: i'm worried about the cleanup. i'll volunteer to wrangle dishes if someone else sponsors napkins.
patrick: i will supply napkins and an industrial-sized jar of hot sauce. deal?
maria: final Q: does the mascot hat come with a name tag for the winner to write the lunch special? hoping for "Patrick's Hot Chip Fiesta" which is a terrible idea and also likely.
ella: locking entries at 6:30pm Friday. Venmo @ella-office (note "nachos") or pay at the door. winner chooses lunch name but can't legally force kitchen to serve it. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
sam: see you Friday. may the crispiest tortilla win. :crossed_fingers:
